guarantees.claim: On asynchronous negedge of rst_ni, done_state_q is reset to DoneAwaitCmd; on rising clk_i when rst_ni is high, done_state_q takes the value of done_state_d.
guarantees.cond: negedge rst_ni or (posedge clk_i and rst_ni)

assumptions.claim: done_state_d must always be driven to a legal encoding of the done state enumeration, otherwise done_state_q could enter an illegal state.
assumptions.risk: An illegal done_state_q value could cause the HMAC done handshake to stall permanently, blocking digest output readout and potentially leaking stale data.

uncertain_points.claim: No local check that done_state_d is within the legal set of DoneAwaitCmd and other valid done states; an illegal value would be latched and propagated.
uncertain_points.cond: done_state_d driven to an out-of-encoding value
uncertain_points.risk: done_state_q becomes illegal, potentially deadlocking the done handshake and preventing access to the HMAC digest result.

uncertain_points.claim: The generation logic for done_state_d is outside this chunk; to verify correctness, the full state transition and encoding must be examined.
uncertain_points.risk: Misencoded or missing transition in done_state_d could cause stuck-at state or premature done signaling, affecting HMAC output timing.
